bio: It is delightful to sit in the shade of the large chestnut tree on the terrace to the rear of this inn, which dates back over 300 years, but the interior is also cosy. Either way, your dedicated hosts are always on hand. They serve Baden cuisine such as Sauerbraten (marinated pot roast) with red cabbage, or pikeperch on a bed of creamed sauerkraut....
